_comment: NSE/BSE trading holiday calendar. UNVERIFIED SEED DATA — cross-check every date against the official NSE circular (nseindia.com > Market Data > Trading Holidays) before relying on this for live staleness checks. Web sources consulted for the 2026 seed disagreed with each other on the Diwali Laxmi Puja date (one gave 20-21 Oct 2026, another gave 08 Nov 2026) — this is exactly the kind of conflict that must not be silently resolved by guessing. Update this file yourself once verified; the loader in config/market_calendar.py treats every entry as authoritative with no independent checking.
